binary-encoded labels (a framework for converting real-valued labels to a binary representation) can be used to improve accuracy for regression problems and that the choice of label encoding, decoding and training loss functions can significantly impact performance.
Binary-encoded labels (BEL) is a framework for encoding real-valued target labels for regression problems into a series of binary values.

(i) we propose BEL as a general framework for converting real-valued labels to binary labels, and demonstrate that it can improve regression accuracy, and (ii) we identify desirable properties of label encodings based on theoretical and experimental study, which highlights a tradeoff between the ability to correct errors in the encoded labels and classification error probability.

the following question: Can we improve regression network accuracy using label encoding and decoding?
